title: a11y (axe wcag2a/aa): unnamed buttons and broken tab roles in the view tab bar, unbound labels on the settings form, and unnamed percent progress bars
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — accessibility | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), item 17. Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-view/src/ViewTabBar.tsx` (the add button about `:888`, the tab roles), `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` (`<Label>` with no `htmlFor`, about `:119`) and `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (the percent progressbar, about `:863`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: axe-core measured these failures on two pages.

## What happens

`/apps/setup/system/settings/auth` has `label` ×15, `button-name` ×9 and `list`/`listitem` ×50. `/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task` has `button-name` ×12 (`button[data-testid="view-tab-add"]`), `aria-progressbar-name` ×10, `aria-required-parent` ×4 and `nested-interactive` ×1 on the view tabs. The add button's tooltip text is hard-coded "Add View".

## Done when

- Each named control gets an accessible name, through translation keys.
- Settings labels bind to their controls, and the tab bar's roles nest validly.
- **Not in this card:** `color-contrast` (100 nodes on seven pages), which is not traced to a file. It is carded once a page is traced.
- **Pin:** axe on the two pages reports none of the listed rules.
